title: UCOS Contract — Response Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema for an operation response contract. Body field-level schema is OPTIONAL and referenced (never inlined/invented). 'outcome' is a transport-neutral result category, NOT an HTTP status code. UCOS-CONTRACT-CAT-001 defines no field-level response schemas. Implementation-neutral.

declared.description: true when a concrete response body schema is defined; false when deferred/absent.

outcome.description: Transport-neutral result category (NOT an HTTP status). E.g. 'success', 'accepted', 'not-found'. Optional.

collection.description: OPTIONAL. true when the response is a paginated/list collection (per the catalog's cursor-pagination obligation).

bodyRef.description: Reference to the response body schema (a payload family) OR a placeholder when the field schema is not defined in the catalog.

$comment: Additive evolution only. 'outcome' is a neutral category set, extensible additively; it MUST NOT be mapped to a concrete transport status here (deferred to Prompt 08). No implementation-specific fields.
